# 💳 gws Docs Write

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the Docs-write module of the gws CLI: append text to a document (`gws docs +write --document <ID> --text <TEXT>`), with a confirmation warning for write operations. Distinct from the already-listed gws-docs (the general Docs module): this is the focused append-text subcommand, same format as the other gws subcommand listings. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: write operations deserve the documented confirmation step — don't script blind appends; the shared auth/security rules live in a separate gws-shared skill the agent must read first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
